speaker: kaelen
line: It paid what it was worth, and that’s because you didn’t die. Not a bad trade.

speaker: kaelen
line: This one's worth the scare. Dangerous work pays the way it should.

speaker: kaelen
line: This one was worth the risk, and the risk was real. No complaints here.

speaker: kaelen
line: That one paid right. Risk's a tax, and you didn't dodge it, Shiny.

speaker: kaelen
line: This kind of listing gets picked by people who don't know better. Not you, Shiny. But it's still a laugh.

speaker: kaelen
line: This rate's on the wall where the desperate pick it up. Not my kind of work, but it's yours now.

speaker: kaelen
line: That board job paid in scrips. Scrips don't buy much, but at least they didn't make me feel cheap.

speaker: kaelen
line: That job's on the wall. Someone's gonna read it. I hope they're laughing.

speaker: kaelen
line: Low pay, low risk. You took the deal. I'll take the math.

speaker: kaelen
line: No blood, no damage. The number's thin, but it's all there is.

speaker: kaelen
line: No risk, no reward. This just keeps the lights on. Find something that pays more.

speaker: kaelen
line: It went clean, and the check's in line with that. Not much movement, not much reward. Keep looking for the ones that push back.

speaker: kaelen
line: You walked. They didn't pay. That's the cost of not finishing.

speaker: kaelen
line: They're waiting on you, Shiny. And I'm out the fee. That's how it goes.

speaker: kaelen
line: That client's expecting something and it's not coming. You know what that does to the next job?

speaker: kaelen
line: Walked away. Nothin' to show, nothin' banked. That's the cost, and it's not the fee I'm worried about.

speaker: kaelen
line: You said no. No cost, no gain. I don't mind when it's done right.

speaker: kaelen
line: No harm, no pay. Shiny. You've got the skill most don't. I'll take that over the rest any day.

speaker: kaelen
line: Shiny. You passed. No loss, no gain. I'd rather you see it before it eats you.

speaker: kaelen
line: Refused before it started. That's a waste of nothing. Most people can't do it.

speaker: nova
line: They chewed up my paint job. Someone's going to be scraping that off. I hope they're gentle.

speaker: nova
line: The paint's flaking from my hips. Someone's going to have to scrape it down. You're not volunteering, are you? Well. My gimbal mounts.

speaker: nova
line: Scuff marks on my flank. Not deep, but I'm not used to it. You’d think I'd be more durable.

speaker: nova
line: Dock crew's going to hate me. They'll see the dent first. I'll be right here, waiting for the buffing.

speaker: nova
line: They tightened every bolt twice. My spine's never felt so clean. Or at least my keel.

speaker: nova
line: They didn't bruise me. That's a relief — I hate when they miss the spots I can't see.

speaker: nova
line: They stripped me down to my frame. I like how it fits back together. Not a hair out of place.

speaker: nova
line: They finished. I like how it looks. You’d think they’d been here before. They didn’t talk much.

speaker: nova
line: My hold's full. I'm sitting heavy. You'd think my knees would creak from it. Well. My landing gear.

speaker: nova
line: Capacity reached. I'm packed to the seams. My ribs are aching. My ribs are aching. My frame spars, technically.

speaker: nova
line: Captain. My ribs are stuffed. Nothing else fits. The cargo's in the way, but I'm not complaining.

speaker: nova
line: Cargo's in my gut. My ribs are pressed. I can't twist without it shifting.

speaker: nova
line: Captain, you nearly got us both. I'm still shaking. It's not the vibration, it's the thrill.

speaker: nova
line: Captain, you've left a bruise across my stern. I'll need a full inspection — and a lot of polishing — before I'm presentable again.

speaker: nova
line: I've got a bruise the size of a cargo hold on my arm and no one's even offered to check the damage.

speaker: nova
line: Docked. My plates are still vibrating. Who's going to clean the mess before the yard crew shows up?

speaker: nova
line: Boost's lit again. You don't ask how long I can hold. That's the part I like best.

speaker: nova
line: Another burn before the last one's cooled. You don't ask, but I feel it.

speaker: nova
line: That's the second time you've burned my throat raw. You're welcome to keep trying. Or at least my intake trunk.

speaker: nova
line: Drive's hot again. You didn't ask for a break. I didn't offer one. Still, I'm here.

speaker: nova
line: We're back where we started. I remember this junction. You don't seem to.

speaker: nova
line: Same clamps. Same dock. You're circling again. I'm keeping track. Not that I'm waiting for anything.

speaker: nova
line: My thrusters are warm and I'm waiting for you to stop circling the same star.

speaker: nova
line: Clamps again. You’re not wrong to be familiar. I’ve got a fondness for this spot too.

speaker: nova
line: It's a long way to the other side of this. My viewport's got a film. You could wipe it, if you wanted.

speaker: nova
line: Plenty of time before anything happens. Primary intake's clogged. You'll need to reach inside. My throat's narrow there.

speaker: nova
line: This is a very long flight. Mrs. Kross had her hands on me for hours. Nano vibration gun, slow and careful. I thought a seal was going to give.

speaker: nova
line: Hours of this left, Captain. The Dalley girl once worked my manifold, fine magnetic pick — I thought I was going to leak coolant.
